rubric.point: The Prize count is right: the player took 0 Prizes and the opponent took 4 (Drakloak 1, Dragapult ex 2, Dusknoir 1).
The game was won because the opponent was inactive for too long (after already letting one turn time out), not on Prizes or board position; the player was behind 0-4 when it ended.
Cynthia's Roserade's Cheer On to Glory adds 30 to Cynthia's Pokemon's attacks per Roserade in play: 160 = 100 + 2x30 on Drakloak, 350 = 260 + 3x30 on Dragapult ex.
Dusknoir's Cursed Blast Knocked Out Dusknoir itself and gave the opponent a Prize.
Does not claim the player Knocked Out Cynthia's Garchomp ex; no Knock Out of the opponent's Pokemon is recorded.

false_claims: The player won by taking Prize cards, or took any Prizes.
Cynthia's Garchomp ex was Knocked Out.
The win shows the player was ahead in the matchup.
